g.text: “अपने द्वारा अपना उद्धार करो, स्वयं को कभी गिरने न दो।
मनुष्य स्वयं ही अपना सबसे बड़ा मित्र है, और स्वयं ही अपना शत्रु।
Elevate your spirit through inner light; you are your own greatest healer and ally.”
BHAGAVAN SRI KRISHNA
— The Bhagavad Gita • Inner Elevation & Self-Mastery (6.5)
“धीरे-धीरे रे मना, धीरे सब कुछ होय।
माली सींचे सौ घड़ा, ऋतु आए फल होय॥
Have patience with your soul; true healing and growth ripen only in their own season.”
SANT KABIR DAS
— Indian Mystic & Poet • Patience, Inner Maturity & Sacred Growth
“I am not what happened to me, I am what I choose to become.
The privilege of a lifetime is to heal your wounds and step into wholeness,
growing courageously into the most authentic and mature version of yourself.”
CARL GUSTAV JUNG
— Pioneer of Depth Psychology • Healing the Shadow & Awakening Wholeness
“To understand yourself requires patience, humility, and endless compassion.
You cannot heal what you constantly judge; true maturity begins the moment
you learn to observe who you are with gentle honesty, and grow with an open heart.”
JIDDU KRISHNAMURTI
— Living Freedom • The Art of Self-Observation & Inner Compassion
